headline: Musician jailed 18 months for AI-bot streaming royalty fraud
summary: A North Carolina musician was sentenced to 18 months in prison for using thousands of bots and AI-generated songs to fraudulently collect streaming royalties. Reports differ on the amount involved, citing either more than $10 million or $8 million stolen from platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music.
